resolution: Built the GLOBAL Blockbench 'Create Texture' flow: a 'textureize' button takes the whole scene and packs it into one sprite-map atlas via a dialog of the exact Blockbench questions. (1) Pure packer editors/model/textureize.ts (textureizeScene, headless 6/6): gathers every face of every part (projected via unwrapMesh), scales by Pixel Density, shelf/bin-packs ALL faces into ONE square atlas (Padding gutters, Power-of-2 rounding), and rewrites every face's uv into the shared atlas so all parts sample ONE texture. (2) CreateTextureDialog (in Studio.tsx) with Blockbench's exact fields — Name, Type (Texture Template/Solid Color/Blank), Pixel Density (16/32/64/128x), Color, Rearrange UV, Power-of-2 Size, Keep Multi Texture Occupancy, Combine Islands, Edge Angle (36), Island Angle (45), Padding. Fully wired today: density, rearrange, power-of-2, padding; the island-merge options + keep-multi are surfaced for parity and carried through (effect is the Phase-2 merge step). (3) A GLOBAL textureize toolbar button opens the dialog; Confirm packs the scene, commits a partMeshUpdated BRANCH edit per part (UVs persisted+undoable), records the atlas params in a studio:tex twig, and shows it. (4) SceneTextureAtlas (TextureAtlas.tsx) renders the whole scene's packed islands into one offscreen StaticSurface from the STORED UVs — colored per-island for Texture Template (image-4 look), flat for Solid, outlines-only for Blank; every part samples it via textureKey under the textured/solid toggle. The per-part req_1062 'create texture' button was replaced by this global flow. editMesh 48/48, modelStream 8/8, textureize 6/6, Studio+TextureAtlas+sources bundle clean. Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed (user leads commits).
